items.label: Injured Workers Pharmacy, LLC to O'Neill and Associates
items.detail: firm_fee; calendar year 2012; The lobbyists of O'Neill and Associates will work with Injured Workers Pharmacy, LLC (IWP) as well as legislature and various state officials regarding the impediments presented by Chapter 244 M.G.L. as to the intent of the law and its application of IWP's business model. We will be working with the following elected officials (including but not limited to), Senator John Keenan, Rep. Liz Malia, Senator Susan Fargo, Rep. Jeffrey Sanchez, Senator Gail Candaras, Rep. Joe Wagner, Senator Daniel Wolf, Rep. Cheryl Coakley-Rivera, Senator Cynthia Stone Creem, Rep. Eugene O'Flaherty, Senator Barry Finegold. Rep. James Lyons, Senate President Therese Murray, Speaker Robert DeLeo, Chairman Brian Dempsey, Chairman Stephen Brewer, Attorney General Martha Coakley as well as Governor Deval Patrick's Office and other executive offices.

We will be working with certain members of the legislature including but not limited to: Senate President Therese Murray, House Speaker Robert DeLeo, House Ways and Means Chairman Brian Dempsey, Senate Ways and Means Chairman Stephen Brewer, Senator John Keenan, Rep. Eugene O'Flaherty, Senator Barry Finegold and Rep. James Lyons as well as State Attorney General's Office and Executive Offices.
